title: Flax
description: Flax is an intelligent nutrition and hydration tracking app built for Nigerian and West African users, with an expanding regional catalogue. Users log meals, track personalised calorie and water targets, and build daily streaks. At the centre is Noura, a domain-locked AI nutrition assistant that knows each user's health goal, dietary style & allergies, answering questions, estimating meal nutrition, and identifying food from a photo with context specific to them.

title: Task Flow
description: A collaborative task management app with real time updates, built with React on the frontend and a Node.js and PostgreSQL backend handling auth and data persistence.

title: Auth Gateway
description: An advanced standalone, integration-ready authentication backend built for developers who prefer to own their auth flow rather than delegate it to a managed service. Designed and implemented the full authentication system including a rotating refresh token architecture with token family tracking and automatic theft detection, httpOnly cookie delivery, in-memory access token strategy, Argon2id password hashing, OTP-gated email verification, Google OAuth with strict provider separation, and per-endpoint rate limiting backed by Redis.

title: Storefront UI
description: A responsive ecommerce interface with cart state management, product filtering, and checkout flow, focused on accessibility and clean component structure.
